notes: Character profiles. Each character has a profile that fills in as you play: the story records what you actually learn about them (basics, looks, personality, likes, dislikes, habits, past, family and friends, work, dreams and fears, secrets). You get a small 📖 notice whenever you discover something new. See them in 🧰 Tools → 📖 Profiles, with how much of each person you've uncovered, or at the bottom of anyone's relationship card. Facts only come from their real character info or what happened in your story, never made up. A character's goal now stays hidden until you know them well enough.
